name: ClipViral
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg && (sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends fonts-inter || echo 'Inter font unavailable, using fallback') && pip install -r requirements.txt

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your Anthropic API key, for AI-picked clips, hooks and captions.
